description: A dark-haired man in a grey shirt and brown leather apron swings an axe-like tool at a large timber beam in a workshop, with wood shavings flying. Other workers are in the background, one carrying a plank over his shoulder. A ship's wooden hull and rigging rise at the right, and a warm light glows from a doorway. The scene is a painted, realistic workshop with no visible text, frame or border.
